declaration: Perception-to-grasp stack for a pick-and-place arm. ROS 2, one camera, Gazebo simulation, and one real arm in the lab. We try ideas in sim first; anything that moves the real arm must be safe. Two of us.
answers: There is an e-stop, and an operator is always present in the lab. No hardware-in-the-loop rig exists. We train the detector on our own images and keep a held-out split. Questions are about feasibility, not design variants. Safety limits are changed only by the operator, by hand.
